svg.title: Light rays bent by a black hole, by impact parameter
svg.desc: Rays with small impact parameter fall in; one circles the photon sphere; the rest deflect.

cc:Work.dc:creator: Nan, hongdam.net
cc:Work.dc:description: computed by tools/figures.py from the equation it shows

svg.text: Light past a black hole, by impact parameter b
b is the distance a ray would have missed the centre by, had it gone straight; rays arrive from the right
b ≈ 5.196 M: circles the photon sphere — the ring in every picture
b > 5.196 M: bent by roughly 4M/b and gone
